title: A DOM form inside a Flutter web app
blurb: A Flutter app compiled for the web shows a real <form> as one of its widgets through createImageFromTextureSource(), and rotates, tilts and blurs it. Two designs: a second canvas over the view, and the form inside Flutter's own canvas.
question: Can a Flutter web app show a live DOM element as part of its own scene through dart:ui_web's createImageFromTextureSource(), with the browser still handling input on the element?
result: Yes. Flutter doesn't take an element or an ElementImage as a texture source, but it takes a 2D canvas that drew the element, and with the multi-surface rasterizer and one patched texImage2D() call it takes the element itself.
